sourcePolicy: Full-view artifacts are complete reading-flow derivatives of approved theory-core, theory-reference and theory-slideshow files. Core has highest semantic precedence.
rules: A full-view file requires approved core, reference and slideshow source versions.
Core remains the source of truth when downstream wording differs.
The full view must provide a complete reading flow without duplicating the full assessment blueprint or implementation code.
Every formula must retain meaning, conditions or warnings and source traceability.
Worked-case values must match approved sources exactly and include reconstruction.
Diagram entries remain semantic mappings and contain no CSS, pixel, color or animation directives.
Full-view files must not include renderer code, runtime wiring, Reader Pro patches or E235 modifications.
Reader compatibility is recorded as a semantic content contract only.
Downstream normalization and integration may consume full-view data but may not override core meaning.
